title: Unchained Whispers
tagline: Unchained Whispers is an AI-driven mystery RPG where every playthrough generates unique NPCs with dynamic secrets and relationships. Unravel a cursed village’s hidden truths—and mint your singular story as a tradeable NFT.
description: Unchained Whispers is an immersive mystery RPG set in a cursed village where every playthrough unveils a new narrative. Each NPC is a decentralized AI agent, capable of making autonomous decisions and reacting uniquely to player interactions. These dynamic agents, generated through a mix-and-match system of attributes, secrets, and relationships, offer a fresh, unpredictable investigation every time. Players must strategically interrogate NPCs with limited questions to deduce the true culprit behind the curse. In a twist that merges storytelling with blockchain, every game save is minted as a protected NFT—turning your unique narrative into a collectible digital artifact.
how_its_made: The project is built on RenPy, which handles the branching narrative and visual novel framework. We integrated OpenAI’s GPT API to generate on-the-fly dialogue, ensuring that each NPC—implemented as a decentralized AI agent—reacts and adapts in a unique way based on their preset mix-and-match attributes. These agents use dynamic decision-making processes to evolve their behavior during interactions. Ethereum smart contracts, leveraging libraries like OpenZeppelin, secure and mint your game save files as NFTs, ensuring your unique story is preserved as a verifiable, tradeable digital asset. This integration of AI, narrative design, and blockchain technology creates a dynamic, immersive experience where every session is a unique journey and collectible artifact.
